name: Frame duplication and deletion
corpus: synthetic photo-like scenes generated from fixed seeds (forensic.validation.run.scene)

detection.task: Were frames removed, or a segment repeated?
detection.positives: 16 8 s clips from four synthetic sources with 1, 5 or 20 frames removed at frame 90, and with frames 40-59 inserted again after frame 119

known_failure_modes: A jump can be a cut, camera switch, light change or a dropped frame. Static scenes, and busy scenes where every frame already changes a lot (the cellular-automaton source here), hide deletions.
Single-frame deletions in slow scenes are often missed (see tpr_by_condition).
Synthetic sources only; CCTV with repeated frames needs the duplicates reading first.
